title: Request to add additional features
body:
This app is very convenient and useful as I love all Microsoft apps. However, it has some limitations compared to other To Do apps. 

As such, would love to have the options to add tags, and an end date when you try to repeat a task. 

Thanks !
author: EllyGaara
